prompt.generated_prompt_string: 360-degree panoramic camera selfie. The camera rotates counter-clockwise through the dessert-shop interior, capturing the adult woman posing in different scenes while wearing different outfits and using different props. Keep the panorama smooth, the subject adult, and each pose and fashion change clear and editorial.
